messages:
maria_csm: Quick sync — pulled BrightLeaf onboarding feedback dump. Lots of small UX asks + two accounts flagged as renewal risks. Can product help triage?

sasha_csm: Thanks — link? I skimmed earlier, looks like repeated notes about session timeouts and confusing per-route billing.

maria_csm: Pasted a short CSV excerpt below and attached the full sheet in the thread (see drive link).

```
customer,pain_point,severity,requested_feature,renewal_risk
BrightLeaf,session timeouts during long chats,high,keepalive token or heartbeat,yes
BrightLeaf,hard to map token usage to routes,medium,per-route cost report,maybe
Greenbridge,low-quality embeddings for short docs,high,embedding tuning controls,no
```

aj_product: Useful, thanks. Proposal: triage into three buckets — (1) immediate onboarding fixes (low dev cost, high renewal impact), (2) short roadmap tickets (small-medium dev), (3) product backlog. Use scoring: severity x frequency x renew_risk.

leo_se: From infra side the session timeouts look like our LB idle timeout hitting clients when KV cache grows. Short-term fix: bump idle to 15m for onboarding infra; long-term: add client-side keepalive. I can prototype the LB change this week.

jane_research: Recommend we create a reproducible prompt+session trace for the timeout case so QA can validate fix. I'll take the headless repro using BrightLeaf logs.

feedback-bot: Tagged messages with labels: [onboarding], [billing-clarity], [embedding-quality].

aj_product: OK actionable plan: (A) Sasha/maria tag all BrightLeaf items as "onboarding-urgent" and put in CS sprint board; (B) Leo -> infra LB change + PR by Fri; (C) Jane -> repro + test case; (D) Product to evaluate per-route billing report feasibility for Q2.

sasha_csm: Will do tagging now and add a short note for account team to pause renewal outreach until fix status is clear.

maria_csm: Also two other customers asked for an "export usage by route" CSV — small UX work but would reduce confusion. Could that be an initial self-serve doc while product scopes the report?

aj_product: Good idea. Leo/jane — can we add a lightweight export endpoint that pulls token usage per route (no UI) and we can surface a one-off CSV? If low effort we'll ship as a stopgap.

leo_se: I can expose an admin-only CSV export behind a toggle in 1-2 days. Will need a short PR and test.

jane_research: I'll write acceptance criteria and example CSV rows to avoid back-and-forth.

maria_csm: Perfect. I'll update the CS board and ping customers with expected timelines. Thanks team :raised_hands:

aj_product: I'll create the triage ticket template in the backlog: fields = customer, impact, frequency, renewal_risk, proposed_mitigation, owner. Use that for future batches so we can prioritize consistently.

sasha_csm: Noted. If anyone sees immediate churn signals, ping me and I'll escalate to sales.

maria_csm: Closing loop — tagging done, Drive link posted, assigning follow-ups in CS board. We should reconvene Friday if LB change or export PR not merged.

feedback-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 3 days.
